interpretation: Elapsed time includes private file open and exact schema validation; SQL and VM counters begin after connection validation.
Storage includes the main database and sidecars present after WAL checkpoint(TRUNCATE).
Entity-filter verification re-reads exact hit references, so returned SQL rows and VM work scale with actual matched hits.
These measurements demonstrate bounded page hydration and indexed ordering; they do not promise constant cost or a fixed latency ceiling.
Current elapsed samples overlapped parallel backend regression; small millisecond differences are not attributed to the implementation.
